CalendarSnapshot.description:
Exchange-sourced, finite coverage; absence inside coverage means closed.

Ingestion supplies verified calendar identity/version. No weekday fallback.
CalendarSnapshot.title: CalendarSnapshot

ContractModel.description: Reject unknown fields and accidental reassignment, not an auth boundary.
ContractModel.title: ContractModel

FreshnessDecision.description: Data prerequisites only. Risk, account, strategy and execution remain separate.
FreshnessDecision.title: FreshnessDecision

FreshnessPolicy.description: Caller must supply a registry-verified policy; there are no defaults.
FreshnessPolicy.title: FreshnessPolicy

IndicatorPoint.description: One computed indicator value at one instant.
IndicatorPoint.title: IndicatorPoint

IndicatorSeries.description: A run of indicator points for one indicator and one parameter set.
IndicatorSeries.title: IndicatorSeries

IndicatorStatus.description: Why an indicator has no value, or that it has one.
IndicatorStatus.title: IndicatorStatus

Money.description: A signed amount and code shape; no rounding, currency lookup or FX.
Money.title: Money

PositionSide.description: Position direction, independent of the broker's buy/sell order side.
PositionSide.title: PositionSide

QuoteEntitlements.description: Reported metadata; actual capability verification is a service duty.
QuoteEntitlements.title: QuoteEntitlements

QuoteSnapshot.description: Per-price ages are relative to as_of, never a live wall clock.
QuoteSnapshot.title: QuoteSnapshot

RecoveryCoverage.description:
Trusted history adapter's pagination/coverage receipt, per subscription.

This is evidence supplied by a verified adapter, not a claim accepted from
consumers. Empty history needs an explicit provider/calendar explanation.
RecoveryCoverage.title: RecoveryCoverage

SequenceRule.description: Omitted channels are opaque. Contiguous numbers must not reset mid-epoch.
SequenceRule.title: SequenceRule

StrategyIntent.description: Strategy output to risk evaluation; not a broker order or approval.
StrategyIntent.title: StrategyIntent

TapeManifest.description: Index of a tape series. `complete=false` means the series is not readable.
TapeManifest.title: TapeManifest

TapePartition.description: One stored file; the checksum binds a dataset to exact stored bytes.
TapePartition.title: TapePartition

TapeReadResult.description:
Rows read back, plus what the reader must be told about their limits.

`rows_outside_retention` counts stored rows that fall outside the
retention window. It is reported rather than silently dropped, so a
caller never mistakes a clipped read for complete history.
TapeReadResult.title: TapeReadResult

TapeSeries.description: Identity and retention of one stored series; not a data payload.
TapeSeries.title: TapeSeries

TapeWriteResult.description: What a write produced; the manifest is the durable record.
TapeWriteResult.title: TapeWriteResult

TradePlan.description: Research/chat output for display; never a strategy/executor input.
TradePlan.title: TradePlan

TradeTick.description: A market print, not an account fill or an instruction to trade.
TradeTick.title: TradeTick
